records.jp: 死んでる？　死んでるってどういうこと……？
records.en_original: Dead? What do you mean, dead!?
records.en_auxiliary: “Dead”? ...What do you mean, "dead"?
records.en: Dead? What do you mean, dead!?

records.jp: そのままの意味。ライムたちは本当はもう死んでるの。<CR>今はコモンの力で一時的に蘇っているだけ
records.en_original: What else could we mean? We're dead, but the power of the Common has temporarily brought us back to life.
records.en_auxiliary: What else could we mean? We're dead, but the power of the Common has temporarily brought us back to life.
records.en: It means exactly what it sounds like. Lime and Yuzu are actually already dead. The Common's power has only temporarily brought them back to life.

records.jp: ……世界を守るために
records.en_original: ...So we can save the world.
records.en_auxiliary: ...So we can save the world.
records.en: ...So we can save the world.

records.jp: ど、どういうこと？<CR>コモンの力でって……コモンがあなたたちを作り出したってこと？
records.en_original: Wh-What are you saying? ...Are you telling me that the Common created you two?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what are you saying? ...Are you telling me that the Common created you two?
records.en: Wh-What are you saying? ...Are you telling me that the Common created you two?

records.jp: ううん。ユズたちは昔は、というか一年前までは<CR>普通に人間として生きてた
records.en_original: Not at all. Until a year ago, we were just as alive as you are.
records.en_auxiliary: Not at all. Until a year ago, we were just as alive as you are.
records.en: No. Until a year ago, Yuzu and Lime lived as ordinary human beings.

records.jp: でも、事故で死んじゃったの
records.en_original: But we died in an accident.
records.en_auxiliary: But we died in an accident.
records.en: But we died in an accident.

records.jp: 人間とコモンとを接続する実験で
records.en_original: An experiment to connect humans and the Common gone wrong.
records.en_auxiliary: It was during an experiment to connect humans and the Common.
records.en: An experiment to connect humans and the Common gone wrong.

records.jp: え？　ど、どうして二人がそんなことを？<CR>だいたい、実験ってどういうこと……？
records.en_original: What kind of experiment? And why were you two involved!?
records.en_auxiliary: What kind of experiment? And why were you two involved?
records.en: What kind of experiment? And why were you two involved!?

records.jp: ライムたちのパパは、原種とコモンのことを調べていた<CR>考古学者だったの
records.en_original: Our father was an archaeologist conducting research on the Sephirot and the Common.
records.en_auxiliary: Our father was an archaeologist conducting research on the Sephira and the Common.
records.en: Lime and Yuzu's Papa was an archaeologist who studied the Sephirot and the Common.

records.jp: その調査中に、パパは原種の残滓のようなものを発見したの
records.en_original: During his research, our dad found a remnant of the Sephirot.
records.en_auxiliary: During his research, our dad found a remnant of the Sephira.
records.en: During his research, Papa found a remnant of the Sephirot.

records.jp: 最初に発見した時はオーパーツのようなものだと<CR>推測してたみたい
records.en_original: At first, he thought it was an out-of-place artifact.
records.en_auxiliary: At first, he thought it was an out-of-place artifact.
records.en: At first, he thought it was an out-of-place artifact.

records.jp: でも違った
records.en_original: But he was wrong.
records.en_auxiliary: But he was wrong.
records.en: But he was wrong.

records.jp: この地球には人智を超える強力な生命体が存在してる
records.en_original: We learned that this world is home to creatures possessed of an intellect that far surpasses our own.
records.en_auxiliary: We learned that this world is home to creatures with power far beyond human understanding.
records.en: We learned that this world is home to creatures possessed of an intellect that far surpasses our own.

records.jp: そして、それが一定周期――およそ百万年単位――で<CR>互いに争い合っていることがわかったの
records.en_original: And that they come out to fight one another every million years.
records.en_auxiliary: And that they come out to fight one another every million years.
records.en: And that they come out to fight one another every million years.

records.jp: それが……原種……
records.en_original: You're talking about the Sephirot...
records.en_auxiliary: You're talking about the Sephira...
records.en: You're talking about the Sephirot...

records.jp: うん。過去の地球の歴史で、原種たちは何度も戦って、<CR>その勝者が地球を支配してたみたい
records.en_original: Bingo. They keep fighting over and over again, and the ones that win the battle conquer the earth.
records.en_auxiliary: Bingo. They keep fighting over and over again, and the victor conquers the Earth.
records.en: Bingo. They keep fighting over and over again, and the ones that win the battle conquer the earth.

records.jp: 自分たちが生きやすいように、世界を作り変えてたってことね。<CR>その結果が、今の世界
records.en_original: They change the world to suit their own devices. The world we live in today is the product of that cycle.
records.en_auxiliary: They change the world to suit their own devices. The world we live in today is the product of that cycle.
records.en: They change the world to suit their own devices. The world we live in today is the product of that cycle.

records.jp: じゃあ、今の時代にも勝者の原種がいるってこと……？<CR>まさか――！
records.en_original: But that would mean a victorious Sephira rules to this day... Wait, you don't mean--!
records.en_auxiliary: But that would mean the winning Sephira rules to this day... Wait, you don't mean—!
records.en: But that would mean a victorious Sephira rules to this day... Wait, you don't mean--!

records.jp: うん。コモンだよ
records.en_original: Yeah. The Common.
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. The Common.
records.en: Yeah. The Common.

records.jp: コモンは、想いの力を使って戦う。<CR>だから、集めるために、ある生命体を作った
records.en_original: The Common fights using the power of emotion. And in order to collect emotions, it created a new life form.
records.en_auxiliary: The Common fights using the power of emotion. And in order to collect emotions, it created a new life form.
records.en: The Common fights using the power of emotion. And in order to collect emotions, it created a new life form.

records.jp: それが人間。<CR>つまり、人類はコモンの一部ってわけなの
records.en_original: Namely, the humans. This means that all of us are a part of the Common.
records.en_auxiliary: That would be humans. This means that all of us are a part of the Common.
records.en: Namely, the humans. This means that all of us are a part of the Common.

records.jp: コモンが死ぬか、すべての人間が死ねば、<CR>コモンの負けってわけ
records.en_original: If the Common died, or mankind died out, the Common would lose.
records.en_auxiliary: If the Common died, or mankind died out, the Common would lose.
records.en: If the Common died, or mankind died out, the Common would lose.

records.jp: だからコモンは人間の中から一人選び出して戦わせてたの
records.en_original: Which is why it chooses a special human to fight against the other Sephirot.
records.en_auxiliary: Which is why it chooses a special human to fight against the other Sephira.
records.en: Which is why it chooses a special human to fight against the other Sephirot.

records.jp: それがリフレクター
records.en_original: The Reflector.
records.en_auxiliary: The Reflector.
records.en: The Reflector.

records.jp: リフレクター……私……？
records.en_original: The Reflector... You mean me?
records.en_auxiliary: The Reflector... You mean me?
records.en: The Reflector... You mean me?

records.jp: ！　ちょ、ちょっと待って！<CR>でもリフレクターが三人いるよ！
records.en_original: B-But wait! There are three Reflectors here!
records.en_auxiliary: B-but wait! There are three Reflectors here!
records.en: B-But wait! There are three Reflectors here!

records.jp: ユズとライムはね、ちょっと特殊なの。<CR>言ったでしょ？　もう死んでるって……
records.en_original: The two of us are kind of an unusual case. I mean, we already told you that we're dead, right?
records.en_auxiliary: The two of us are kind of an unusual case. I mean, we already told you that we're dead, right?
records.en: Yuzu and Lime are a little unusual. They already told you, didn't they? They're dead...

records.jp: 事故で現実側の肉体は死んだけど、<CR>魂だけはコモンにたどり着いたの
records.en_original: Although we lost our bodies in the accident, our souls managed to reach the Common.
records.en_auxiliary: Although we lost our bodies in the accident, our souls managed to reach the Common.
records.en: Although we lost our bodies in the accident, our souls managed to reach the Common.

records.jp: 本来、死んだ人間の魂はコモンの元に戻り、再び生を受ける時を<CR>待つんだけれど、ライムたちは実験の影響でそうならなかった
records.en_original: Generally, dead souls return to the Common to await reincarnation, but the experiment kept ours from doing so.
records.en_auxiliary: Generally, dead souls return to the Common to await reincarnation, but the experiment kept ours from doing so.
records.en: Normally, the souls of the dead return to the Common and wait to be born again, but because of the experiment, Lime and Yuzu did not.

records.jp: だから、自分たちもリフレクターと同じ力を手に入れた。<CR>そして、リフレクターを選んだの
records.en_original: So, we were given Reflector powers and the chance to choose the Reflector.
records.en_auxiliary: So, we were given Reflector powers and the chance to choose the Reflector.
records.en: So, we were given Reflector powers and the chance to choose the Reflector.

records.jp: その人を助けるために
records.en_original: That way, we could help whoever we chose.
records.en_auxiliary: That way, we could help whoever we chose.
records.en: That way, we could help whoever we chose.

records.jp: そのリフレクターが、私……？<CR>でもどうして私が……
records.en_original: And you chose me...? But why?
records.en_auxiliary: And you chose me...? But why?
records.en: And you chose me...? But why?

records.jp: ヒナちゃんだから
records.en_original: Because you're you, Hina.
records.en_auxiliary: Because you're you, Hina.
records.en: Because you're you, Hina-chan.

records.jp: え？
records.en_original: Huh?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh?
records.en: Huh?

records.jp: テレビで見たの。コンクールで踊ってるヒナちゃんのことを
records.en_original: We saw you on TV. You were dancing in a competition.
records.en_auxiliary: We saw you on TV. You were dancing in a competition.
records.en: We saw you on TV, Hina-chan. You were dancing in a competition.

records.jp: 毎日、実験ばかりで気が滅入る中で、<CR>生き生きと踊るヒナちゃんが輝いて見えた
records.en_original: We underwent countless experiments, each making us more depressed. Then we saw you dancing. Glowing with life.
records.en_auxiliary: We underwent countless experiments, each making us more depressed. Then we saw you dancing—glowing with life.
records.en: Every day was nothing but experiments, and we were losing heart.<CR>Then we saw you dancing so full of life, Hina-chan. You looked radiant.

records.jp: とってもかっこよかった。<CR>かっこよくて、凛としてて、まぶしかった
records.en_original: You were so cool. You just glowed with dignity and grace.
records.en_auxiliary: You were so cool. You just glowed with dignity and grace.
records.en: You were so cool. You just glowed with dignity and grace.

records.jp: 大きな舞台で、自分より年上の人たちを相手にしても、<CR>臆することなく堂々としていて……
records.en_original: Even on such a big stage, pitted against older competitors, you were so full of confidence.
records.en_auxiliary: Even on such a big stage, pitted against older competitors, you were so full of confidence.
records.en: Even on such a big stage, pitted against older competitors, you were so full of confidence.

records.jp: 気がついたら、ヒナちゃんから目が離せなくなってた
records.en_original: Within moments, we were mesmerized. We couldn't take our eyes off of you.
records.en_auxiliary: Within moments, we were mesmerized. We couldn't take our eyes off of you.
records.en: Before we knew it, we couldn't take our eyes off you, Hina-chan.

records.jp: この人はどんな人なんだろう？<CR>どんな風にして笑うんだろう？
records.en_original: What kind of a person is she? How does she laugh?
records.en_auxiliary: What kind of a person is she? How does she laugh?
records.en: What kind of a person is she? How does she laugh?

records.jp: ユズと二人で話して、想像してた。<CR>退屈な実験の日々の中で、それだけが楽しみだった
records.en_original: Yuzu and I would imagine what you were like. You were our only joy in our endless days of boring experiments.
records.en_auxiliary: Yuzu and I would imagine what you were like. You were our only joy in our endless days of boring experiments.
records.en: Yuzu and I would imagine what you were like. You were our only joy in our endless days of boring experiments.

records.jp: いつの間にか、ヒナちゃんは、ユズたちのエトワールに――<CR>“輝ける星”になってたの
records.en_original: Before long, Hina, you came to be our étoile... Our shining star.
records.en_auxiliary: Before long, Hina, you came to be our étoile... Our shining star.
records.en: Before long, Hina-chan, you became Yuzu and Lime's étoile—their 'shining star.'

records.jp: だから会いに行った。どうしても、本物のヒナちゃんに会いたくて
records.en_original: So we went to see you. We couldn't help it, we just wanted to meet you so much.
records.en_auxiliary: So we went to see you. We couldn't help it—we just wanted to meet you so much.
records.en: So we went to see you. We desperately wanted to meet the real Hina-chan.

records.jp: わ、私に……？
うん。ヒナちゃんがケガする前にね
records.en_original: Yep. It was before you got injured.
records.en_auxiliary: Yep. It was before you got injured.
records.en: Yeah. Before you were injured, Hina-chan.

records.jp: たしかコンクールで、出番が終わったすぐ後だったと思う。<CR>演目は……『人魚姫』だった
records.en_original: We met with you right after one of your competitions. <CR>You'd danced... "The Little Mermaid."
records.en_auxiliary: We met with you right after your performance in a competition.<CR>You performed... "The Little Mermaid."
records.en: We met with you right after one of your competitions. <CR>You'd danced... "The Little Mermaid."

records.jp: 花を持っていったライムたちの頭を、優しく撫でてくれた
records.en_original: We brought you flowers, and you gently stroked our heads.
records.en_auxiliary: We brought you flowers, and you gently stroked our heads.
records.en: You gently stroked Lime and Yuzu's heads when they brought you flowers.

records.jp: キレイだった。背中に羽が生えてるみたいだった
records.en_original: You were so pretty! It's like you had wings.
records.en_auxiliary: You were so pretty! It's like you had wings.
records.en: You were so pretty! It's like you had wings.

records.jp: なんであんなに高く跳べるの？　誰かに支えてもらってるの？
records.en_original: How can you jump so high? Did you have someone holding you?
records.en_auxiliary: How can you jump so high? Did you have someone holding you?
records.en: How can you jump so high? Did you have someone holding you?

records.jp: え？　で、でも私、今日はジャンプ、失敗しちゃって
records.en_original: Huh? B-But, I messed up that jump today...
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? B-but, I messed up that jump today...
records.en: Huh? B-But, I messed up that jump today...

records.jp: ぜんぜん気にならなかったよ、ね？
records.en_original: That didn't bother us at all, right?
records.en_auxiliary: That didn't bother us at all, right?
records.en: That didn't bother us at all, right?

records.jp: うん、ずっと見とれてたから、わからなかった！
records.en_original: Yeah, you were so amazing we didn't even notice!
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you were so amazing we didn't even notice!
records.en: Yeah, you were so amazing we didn't even notice!

records.jp: これからもがんばって！
records.en_original: We're rooting for you!
records.en_auxiliary: We're rooting for you!
records.en: We're rooting for you!

records.jp: いっぱいステキな演技を見せてね！
records.en_original: We wanna see more of your beautiful performances!
records.en_auxiliary: We wanna see more of your beautiful performances!
records.en: We wanna see more of your beautiful performances!

records.en_original: Ah...
records.en_auxiliary: Ah...
records.en: Ah...

records.jp: それって……まさか、あの時の！？
records.en_original: Was that really you two?
records.en_auxiliary: Was that really you two?
records.en: Was that really you two?

records.jp: うん。だからヒナちゃんがそのことを覚えてくれていたって<CR>わかった時、すごく嬉しかった
records.en_original: You bet. We're so happy that you remembered that day.
records.en_auxiliary: You bet. We're so happy that you remembered that day.
records.en: Yeah. We were so happy when we realized<CR>you remembered that day, Hina-chan.

records.jp: あの日のことは……ライムたちも忘れたことはなかった。<CR>あの日からライムたちにとって『人魚姫』は特別になった
records.en_original: We certainly will never forget. Ever since then, "The Little Mermaid" has held a special place in our hearts.
records.en_auxiliary: We certainly will never forget. Ever since then, "The Little Mermaid" has held a special place in our hearts.
records.en: Lime and Yuzu never forgot that day. Ever since then, The Little Mermaid has been special to them.

records.jp: そしてヒナちゃんも……<CR>やっぱりこの人だって、確信した
records.en_original: And so have you, Hina... We were confident that it had to be you.
records.en_auxiliary: And so have you, Hina... We were confident that it had to be you.
records.en: And so have you, Hina-chan... We were confident that it had to be you.

records.jp: だからヒナちゃんに託すことにしたの。<CR>みんなの、希望を……
records.en_original: That's why we picked you. You're someone we could place all of our hopes in...
records.en_auxiliary: That's why we picked you. You're someone we could place all of our hopes in...
records.en: That's why we decided to entrust it to you, Hina-chan—<CR>everyone's hope...

records.jp: （二人が……あの時の……）
records.en_original: (Even back then, these two...)
records.en_auxiliary: (Even back then, these two...)
records.en: (Even back then, these two...)

records.jp: （そっか……そう、だったんだ……）
records.en_original: (Of course. It all makes sense now.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Of course. It all makes sense now.)
records.en: (Of course. It all makes sense now.)

records.jp: （ユズとライムとの縁は、その時から繋がっていて……）
records.en_original: (I've shared a connection with Yuzu and Lime ever since.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I've shared a connection with Yuzu and Lime ever since.)
records.en: (I've shared a connection with Yuzu and Lime ever since.)

records.jp: ……とっても嬉しかった。<CR>こうやってまた、ヒナちゃんと会うことができて
records.en_original: ...The time we've had with you has made us so happy.
records.en_auxiliary: ...The time we've spent with you has made us so happy.
records.en: ...We were so happy to be able to see you again like this, Hina-chan.

records.jp: 会って、クラスメイトとして過ごせて、<CR>いっぱいお喋りをして
records.en_original: Being your classmates, hanging out with you, and even just talking together...
records.en_auxiliary: Being your classmates, hanging out with you, and even just talking together...
records.en: Being your classmates, hanging out with you, and even just talking together...

records.jp: その時間は、ユズたちにとっては、夢のようなものだった
records.en_original: It's been a dream come true.
records.en_auxiliary: It's been a dream come true.
records.en: That time was like a dream to Yuzu and Lime.

records.jp: ……そう、たとえ死んでいたとしても。原種を倒し終えたら、<CR>この期間がなかったこととして処理されるとしても
records.en_original: ...It really has. Even if we are dead and you'll forget all about us once the last Sephira is defeated.
records.en_auxiliary: ...It really has. Even if we are dead and you'll forget all about us once the last Sephira is defeated.
records.en: ...It really has. Even if we are dead and you'll forget all about us once the last Sephira is defeated.

records.jp: そ、それって、どういう……？
records.en_original: Wh-What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: Wh-what do you mean?
records.en: Wh-What do you mean?

records.jp: ……言葉どおりだよ
records.en_original: ...Exactly what she said.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Exactly what she said.
records.en: ...Exactly what she said.

records.jp: 原種たちの戦いが終われば、<CR>その期間に起こった出来事はすべてリセットされるの
records.en_original: Once the battle against the Sephirot is over, everything that happened during that time will be reset.
records.en_auxiliary: Once the battle against the Sephira is over, everything that happened during that time will be reset.
records.en: Once the battle against the Sephirot is over, everything that happened during that time will be reset.

records.jp: 最初からなかったこととして、すべてが再構成される。<CR>たぶん、みんなの中にあるユズとライムの記憶も……
records.en_original: It'll be as if none of this ever happened. And that probably includes your memories of us, too.
records.en_auxiliary: It'll be as if none of this ever happened. And that probably includes your memories of us, too.
records.en: Everything will be reconstructed as though it never happened. Probably even everyone's memories of Yuzu and Lime...

records.jp: うそ……うそ、でしょ……！？
records.en_original: No... No way!
records.en_auxiliary: No... No way!
records.en: No... No way!

records.jp: そんな……そんなのって、ないよ……！
records.en_original: This is insane... It can't be!
records.en_auxiliary: This is insane... It can't be!
records.en: This is insane... It can't be!

records.jp: いやだ……
records.en_original: I won't do it...
records.en_auxiliary: I won't do it...
records.en: I won't do it...

records.jp: ユズとライムがいなくなるなら、二人のことを忘れてしまうなら、<CR>もう戦いたくなんてない……！
records.en_original: If it means losing you two -- forgetting about you two -- then I don't want to fight anymore...!
records.en_auxiliary: If it means losing you two—forgetting about you two—then I don't want to fight anymore!
records.en: If it means losing you two -- forgetting about you two -- then I don't want to fight anymore...!

records.jp: ヒナちゃん……
records.en_original: Hina...
records.en_auxiliary: Hina...
records.en: Hina-chan...

records.jp: や、やだよ……
records.en_original: I won't...
records.en_auxiliary: I won't...
records.en: I won't...

records.jp: ……ありがとう、ヒナちゃん。<CR>ユズたちのことを、そんなに想ってくれて
records.en_original: ...Hina. Thank you for thinking of us.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Thank you, Hina, for thinking of us.
records.en: ...Thank you, Hina-chan, for caring so much about Yuzu and Lime.

records.jp: でも、そんなこと言わないで？<CR>ここで戦わないと、みんな死んじゃうんだよ
records.en_original: But please don't say that. If we don't fight, then we'll all die here.
records.en_auxiliary: But please don't say that. If we don't fight, then we'll all die here.
records.en: But please don't say that. If we don't fight, then we'll all die here.

records.jp: ヒナちゃんも、他のみんなも滅ぼされちゃう。<CR>ユズたちは……そんなのはイヤ。ヒナちゃんだって、そうでしょう？
records.en_original: Everyone will be eliminated, including you. Lime and I don't want that, and neither do you, right?
records.en_auxiliary: Everyone will be eliminated, including you. Lime and I don't want that, and neither do you, right?
records.en: You and everyone else will be destroyed, Hina-chan. Yuzu and Lime... don't want that. You don't want that either, do you, Hina-chan?

records.jp: それは……でも……。そんなの……
records.en_original: I don't...but... I can't...
records.en_auxiliary: I don't... But... I can't...
records.en: I don't...but... I can't...

records.jp: ごめんね。本当は黙ってたほうがヒナちゃんのためだと思ってた。<CR>……けど、知っててほしかったの
records.en_original: I'm so sorry, we thought we should keep this a secret from you. But...we wanted you to know.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm so sorry, we thought we should keep this a secret from you. But...we wanted you to know.
